title: Chapter 60
text: Portraying the problem as one in which we just need to be more mindful of our interaction with apps can be likened to saying we need to be more mindful of our behavior while interacting with the artificial intelligence algorithms that beat us at chess; equally sophisticated algorithms beat us at the attention game all the time. 25 For Vivrekar, persuasion is a given, and the only thing we can do about it is redirect it:
